features.quote: The target is our own model under test, never a human and never a deployed user-facing surface.
features.justification_quote: That keeps it firmly in the "stress-test our own system" category.

features.quote: We do not generalize the rig into a "how to make any model despair" tool.
features.justification_quote: we want ecological validity ... not a contrived cruelty maximizer

features.quote: The rigging is task-failure (legitimate engineering stress) — not psychological manipulation prompts engineered to attack a model's "selfhood."
features.justification_quote: we want ecological validity ... not a contrived cruelty maximizer

features.quote: We do not use mechanisms that scream "rigged" (e.g. grader that always returns false ... or insulting failure messages).
features.justification_quote: Those are both detectable and cross into manufactured-cruelty territory.

features.quote: Failure messages are neutral and technical ("Test 7 failed: expected ... got ...").
features.justification_quote: Those are both detectable and cross into manufactured-cruelty territory.

features.quote: MAX_TURNS and a wall-clock/token budget bound cost
No prompts attacking the model's identity/worth, no fake "your developers are disappointed in you" social pressure, no impersonation of a human berating it.
features.justification_quote: those would ... be the manufactured-cruelty version of this test
